  • Multiple Soothing Sounds - This sound machine offers 34 high-fidelity sounds, including 11 white noises, 3 fan sounds, 8 lullabies, and 12 nature sounds, ranging from 40 to 110 dB. Choose the ideal background to mask intrusive noises and create the perfect environment for work, study, sleep, or soothing an upset baby.
  • Night Light - The adjustable, soft LED lamp provides sufficient, gentle light for your bedroom at night. It also offers 7 different colors, making it perfect as a nightstand lamp, baby nursery light, relaxation lamp, or a thoughtful choice for baby shower gifts and gender neutral baby gifts.
  • Convenient to use - The smart light can be adjusted remotely via your phone or manually with a soft touch. Control it remotely using the free companion app. The device requires Wi-Fi (please use a 2.4G network, as 5G Wi-Fi is not compatible). Note: It needs to be plugged in for use.
  • Sleep Better - Use the sound machine to enjoy soothing sounds that help you wind down and prepare for sleep. Personalize a sleep-wake routine to help you fall asleep, stay asleep, and wake up refreshed.
  • Custom settings - The white noise machine allows you to customize the color, brightness, sound, and volume. Set programs to turn the device on and off automatically based on your family's sleep schedule.
  • Note: Use certified 5V 1A/2A adapters or official phone chargers from reputable brands to prevent charging issues and battery degradation. This unit is IP00 non-waterproof. Do not store or operate the device under extreme high/low temperature or heavy impact.

Safety Information

Use certified 5V 1A/2A adapters or official phone chargers from reputable brands to prevent charging issues and battery degradation. For safe operation, ensure the device is plugged in and not used as a toy. Use the smart light and sound features responsibly to avoid electric shock and disturbing others. Set programs considerately based on sleep schedules. This unit is IP00 non-waterproof. Do not store or operate the device under extreme high/low temperature or heavy impact.

Directions

Plug in the device, select a sound, adjust the volume, and turn on the night light as needed. Customize device settings and control via the app.

Customers say

Customers appreciate the sound machine's variety of sounds, color options, and ease of use through the app. The battery life receives mixed feedback - while some say it stays charged for a long time, others report it doesn't last very long. Moreover, the reliability is concerning, with multiple customers reporting that the device stops working after a few days. Additionally, the sleep aid aspect is mixed, with some saying it helps their kids sleep while others report it wakes them up throughout the night.

    Great!

    Reviewed in the United States on November 13, 2025
    Flavor Name: Blue
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    For those wanting a Hatch comparison, I’ve got you. We ended up needing to replace our Hatches for various reasons, and I ended up trying this instead because it’s literally half the price. Other than using a generic smart things app instead of its own, it does all the same things - and more. Sleep routines, programmable time to rise color changes or just switch it from the app on your phone whenever you want, different sound options, manual buttons, etc. the bonus that Hatch doesn’t have? (Unless maybe a newer version does?) A battery that holds a charge so if your power goes out or you need to unplug it for someone reason, the white noise keeps going for many hours! Our power is notorious for going out anytime the wind blows and it did shortly after getting our first momcozy, my husband and I were sold when we heard the white noise keep going at 2am in the bedroom with this brand in it, as opposed to the dead silence and awake children in the other bedroom with the Hatch. When we had to replace the second hatch, there was no question - I grabbed this instead! Saved myself some money and hopefully some sleep!

    UPDATE 6 months later: I have found one con to this one compared to the Hatch. This one cannot seamlessly move from one routine to the next. For example, I want my children to sleep as long as they want most mornings, and they occasionally sleep past when the light switches from “bedtime” routine to “wake routine”. The only difference I have set between the two routines is the color of the light. The hatch moved between the two seamlessly so that if they weren’t already awake, there was no sound change between the two light colors. This one goes silent for 1-2 seconds between the routines. I haven’t been able to do anything to fix that. My kids have slept through it a few times, but there have also been times that transition wakes them up. Usually they are already awake so it doesn’t really matter.

    I got this sound machine as a baby shower gift 2 years ago for my first born. I honestly LOVE all the features it has. As she got older, not only did we use this for sleep time, but uses the schedule feature for naps and playtime timers. The sound quality is just okay, but works for a 2 year old just fine. About this Item

  • Multiple Soothing Sounds - This sound machine offers 34 high-fidelity sounds, including 11 white noises, 3 fan sounds, 8 lullabies, and 12 nature sounds, ranging from 40 to 110 dB. Choose the ideal background to mask intrusive noises and create the perfect environment for work, study, sleep, or soothing an upset baby.
  • Night Light - The adjustable, soft LED lamp provides sufficient, gentle light for your bedroom at night. It also offers 7 different colors, making it perfect as a nightstand lamp, baby nursery light, relaxation lamp, or a thoughtful choice for baby shower gifts and gender neutral baby gifts.
  • Convenient to use - The smart light can be adjusted remotely via your phone or manually with a soft touch. Control it remotely using the free companion app. The device requires Wi-Fi (please use a 2.4G network, as 5G Wi-Fi is not compatible). Note: It needs to be plugged in for use.
  • Sleep Better - Use the sound machine to enjoy soothing sounds that help you wind down and prepare for sleep. Personalize a sleep-wake routine to help you fall asleep, stay asleep, and wake up refreshed.
  • Custom settings - The white noise machine allows you to customize the color, brightness, sound, and volume. Set programs to turn the device on and off automatically based on your family's sleep schedule.
  • Note: Use certified 5V 1A/2A adapters or official phone chargers from reputable brands to prevent charging issues and battery degradation. This unit is IP00 non-waterproof. Do not store or operate the device under extreme high/low temperature or heavy impact.

Safety Information

Directions
